name: tradeberry
description: tradeBerry — browser FX trading terminal (simulated market seeded with ECB rates)

scripts.dev:server: npm run release && npx wrangler d1 migrations apply tradeberry --local && npx wrangler pages dev --port 8788
scripts.deploy: npm run release && npx wrangler d1 migrations apply tradeberry --remote && npx wrangler pages deploy --branch main
scripts.deploy:ui: npm run release && npx wrangler pages deploy --branch main
